metadata.title: Lumi.

home.title: Lumi helps students handle mental overload before it becomes a crisis.
home.description: A Czech, privacy-first app for recognizing what is happening, calming down in difficult moments, and finding real human support when needed.

problem.title: The problem
problem.description: Many students feel stuck between 'I can still handle this' and 'I need help.' They experience stress, anxiety, and overwhelm, but don't know whether to seek therapy, call a crisis line, or simply find a way to understand what's happening. Existing options are fragmented—each solving only part of the problem.

points.title: Unsupported middle ground
points.desc: Many students don't feel well but don't know if it's time to seek help yet.

points.title: Fragmented solutions
points.desc: Therapy, crisis lines, apps, and sites often only solve one part of the problem.

points.title: Low-barrier first step
points.desc: Lumi helps you start safely: name the state, calm down, and find further support.

vision.title: What is Lumi?
vision.description: Many students are stuck between 'I can still handle this' and 'I need help.' They feel stressed, overwhelmed or anxious, but do not always know whether they need therapy, crisis support or just a way to understand what is happening. Lumi is a safe first step—not therapy, not crisis service, but supportive prevention that helps students recognize patterns, stabilize during difficult moments, and find real human support when needed.
vision.marketAnalysis: Lumi is designed for students who feel overwhelmed, but it can also support schools, universities and counselling centres as a low-threshold prevention tool. It gives students a first step outside consultation hours and helps them understand when it may be time to reach out for human support.

whatLumiIsNot.title: Lumi Boundaries
whatLumiIsNot.description: Lumi is not therapy, diagnosis, or a crisis service. It is a supportive prevention tool that helps students orient themselves in their own state, manage difficult moments, and find human support.

items.clarification: Only professionals provide diagnosis and treatment. Lumi helps with self-reflection, stabilization, and direction to support.
Lumi is not a replacement for psychologists, psychiatrists, or crisis workers. It serves as a first step and bridge to human help.

items.claim: Not an emergency or crisis service
items.clarification: In an urgent situation, it is necessary to contact a crisis line, emergency services, or a trusted person.

items.q: What if I feel really bad?
items.a: Lumi is not an emergency service. If you feel unable to stay safe, contact 112, crisis line 116 123, or a trusted person immediately.

screener.heading: Try a 1-minute wellbeing check
screener.intro: These are evidence-informed self-reflection tools based on internationally used questionnaires. Your answers stay in your browser—nothing is stored or sent anywhere. The result is for your personal reflection only, not a diagnosis. If anything resonates, please talk to a mental-health professional.
screener.pickPrompt: Which check would you like to try?

who5.name: WHO-5 · Wellbeing
who5.blurb: 5 questions · general wellbeing over the past 2 weeks
items: I have felt cheerful and in good spirits
I have felt calm and relaxed
I have felt active and vigorous
I woke up feeling fresh and rested
My daily life has been filled with things that interest me

phq9.name: PHQ-9 · Depression
phq9.blurb: 9 questions · mood over the past 2 weeks
phq9.timeframe: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by…
items: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
Feeling down, depressed, or hopeless
Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
Feeling tired or having little energy
Poor appetite or overeating
Feeling bad about yourself - or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down
Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading or watching television
Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed - or being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual
Thoughts that you would be better off dead, or of hurting yourself in some way

gad7.name: GAD-7 · Anxiety
gad7.blurb: 7 questions · anxiety over the past 2 weeks
gad7.timeframe: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by…
items: Feeling nervous, anxious or on edge
Not being able to stop or control worrying
Worrying too much about different things
Trouble relaxing
Being so restless that it is hard to sit still
Becoming easily annoyed or irritable
Feeling afraid as if something awful might happen

ui.disclaimer: Screening tools are not a diagnosis. If anything here resonates, consider talking to a mental-health professional.
ui.crisisTitle: Please reach out - you are not alone
ui.crisisBody: Your answers suggest it would help to talk to someone now. In the Czech Republic call 116 123 (Linka první psychické pomoci, 24/7) or 112 in an emergency. If you are in immediate danger, contact local emergency services.
